analysis.title: Pentair Plc (PNR): First Take: Solid 3Q26 beat; guidance steady as Pool destock appears complete
key_insights: PNR reported 3Q26 revenue of $976mn and non-GAAP adj. EPS of $1.18, above GSe and FactSet consensus of $964mn and $1.07.
FY2026 revenue guidance was raised to about down 3% yoy (prior: down about 4%-7%), implying about $4.05bn vs GSe $3.93bn and consensus $3.97bn.
FY2026 adj. EPS guidance midpoint was reaffirmed at about $4.70 (range was $4.60-$4.80), vs GSe $4.69 and consensus $4.65.
Management said the Pool channel inventory destock was completed during the quarter, which GS says positions Pool for growth in 2027 with no end-market recovery assumed.
4Q26 guide is mixed: sales up about 7%-9% yoy ($1,092mn-$1,112mn) vs GSe $993mn and consensus about $1,036mn, but adj. EPS of about $1.15 (down about 3% yoy) is below GSe $1.26 and consensus $1.21.
3Q26 sales were down 4% yoy (core down 5%) as pricing and acquisitions partly offset volume declines.
Pool sales of $292mn fell 18% yoy (core also down 18%) on channel destocking, but beat GSe of $269mn.
Water Solutions sales of $422mn rose 1% yoy, slightly below GSe $425mn. Commercial rose 4% and residential fell 1%.
Industrial and Flow Technologies sales of $263mn rose 4% yoy (core +1%), below GSe $268mn, driven by pricing and acquisitions, partly offset by lower volumes and FX.
3Q26 adj. operating income of $242mn, including about $8mn of tariff refund benefit, fell 8% yoy. Adj. return on sales of 24.8% was down 90bps yoy and above GSe 23.1%.
GS rates PNR Neutral with a 12-month price target of $60 (12x P/E on Q5-Q8 EPS), vs a $55.22 price, implying 8.7% upside.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Neutral and a $60 target (12x P/E on Q5-Q8 EPS) after a 3Q26 beat. The target is 8.7% above the $55.22 price.
